tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page and panel ground. Warm paper, never pure white.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Lanes, cards, sheets, inputs: anything that sits on paper.

tokens.name: paper-sunk
tokens.usage: Wells: the session bar track, code-like handoff preview, disabled fields.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text, headings and the ink line on paper, paper-raised and paper-sunk. Also control borders.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (task labels, timestamps, hints) on paper, paper-raised and paper-sunk.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers inside cards. Decorative only: never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Quiet control edges (inputs at rest, quiet buttons). 3:1 on paper and paper-raised.

tokens.name: awning
tokens.usage: The red of the red-and-white awning stripe. Decoration and the finish post only, never text.

tokens.name: awning-white
tokens.usage: The white of the awning stripe and the finish-line chalk.

tokens.name: red-ink
tokens.usage: Red text and error copy on paper and paper-raised; primary button fill (light).

tokens.name: on-red-ink
tokens.usage: Label on a red-ink fill (primary button).

tokens.name: turf
tokens.usage: Track ground in every lane.

tokens.name: turf-stripe
tokens.usage: Mowing stripes on the track; they scroll left while a horse is working.

tokens.name: turf-rail
tokens.usage: Rail and gate bars at the start of the track.

tokens.name: turf-lip
tokens.usage: The glossy front lip of each stepped row on the lawn.

tokens.name: turf-riser
tokens.usage: The shaded face under each stepped row; gives the lawn its depth.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Painted backdrop behind the lawn, top of the widget.

tokens.name: hill
tokens.usage: Painted hills on the backdrop.

tokens.name: bulb
tokens.usage: Your-turn marker: the lit bulb on the finish post and the Your turn chip fill.

tokens.name: on-bulb
tokens.usage: Text and icons on bulb.

tokens.name: bulb-tint
tokens.usage: Background of a lane whose horse is at the finish (Your turn).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2px solid with 2px offset. 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links on paper and paper-raised (usage page, source repos).

tokens.name: silk-claude
tokens.usage: Claude lanes: saddle cloth, jockey silks, service chip fill.

tokens.name: on-silk-claude
tokens.usage: Text on silk-claude (service chip).

tokens.name: silk-chatgpt
tokens.usage: ChatGPT lanes: saddle cloth, jockey silks, service chip fill.

tokens.name: on-silk-chatgpt
tokens.usage: Text on silk-chatgpt.

tokens.name: silk-gemini
tokens.usage: Gemini lanes: saddle cloth, jockey silks, service chip fill. Always paired with an ink outline (yellow alone is too light on paper).

tokens.name: on-silk-gemini
tokens.usage: Text on silk-gemini.

tokens.name: silk-grok
tokens.usage: Grok lanes: saddle cloth, jockey silks, service chip fill. Added Nov 25 by the coding agent; design agent may revise.

tokens.name: on-silk-grok
tokens.usage: Text on silk-grok.

tokens.name: silk-imported
tokens.usage: Imported (pasted) lanes: saddle cloth, jockey silks, service chip fill.

tokens.name: on-silk-imported
tokens.usage: Text on silk-imported.

tokens.name: horse-coat
tokens.usage: The chestnut coat of every horse. The silk carries the lane colour, not the horse.

tokens.name: horse-coat-far
tokens.usage: The far-side legs, a shade darker so the gallop reads.

tokens.name: prov-counted
tokens.usage: Counted tag: solid fill (with paper text).

tokens.name: prov-estimate
tokens.usage: ≈ Estimate tag: dashed outline and text on paper-raised.

tokens.name: prov-said
tokens.usage: You said tag: text and pen underline on paper-raised.

tokens.name: prov-na
tokens.usage: Not available tag: struck-through text on paper-raised.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind the consent sheet.

styles.name: marquee
styles.usage: The wordmark and report title. Uppercase. Once per screen at most.

styles.name: sign
styles.usage: Report section titles and onboarding headings. Uppercase.

styles.name: post-number
styles.usage: The lane number on the post at the left of each lane.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Derby reads the claude.ai pages you open so it can tell you when a chat is done.

styles.name: lane-title
styles.usage: The task label inside a lane.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, state labels, field labels, toggles.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Hints and secondary lines. Never below 13px.

styles.name: count
styles.usage: Message counts and any number. Tabular.

styles.name: note
styles.usage: Annotations the person wrote or rated (You said), onboarding margin notes. Never for controls.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, tag padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside a lane between rows; button padding-y.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Lane padding, panel side gutter.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding (panel width).

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding (report width), gaps between report cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section spacing in the report.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Report page margins at 1280.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Track, awning stripes, finish post: painted wood is square.

tokens.name: radius-1
tokens.usage: Provenance tags, toggles' knob well, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-2
tokens.usage: Buttons, lanes, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-3
tokens.usage: Report cards, consent sheet.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: State chips and the badge.

tokens.name: shadow-press
tokens.usage: Primary and secondary buttons only: the ink lip of a booth button. Collapses to 0 when pressed.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Consent sheet and toasts: the only floating layers.

border.note: Stroke widths. The ink line is Derby's signature: draw edges, don't float them.

tokens.name: border-hair
tokens.usage: Dividers (rule).

tokens.name: border-ink
tokens.usage: The ink line: lanes, cards, buttons, chips, tags.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Your-turn lane outline and focus ring.

size.note: Layout sizes the panel depends on.

tokens.name: panel-min
tokens.usage: Narrowest side panel.

tokens.name: panel-mock
tokens.usage: Side-panel mockup width.

tokens.name: lane-height
tokens.usage: One lane at panel width; six fit in 900px with header and session bar.

tokens.name: track-height
tokens.usage: The turf strip inside a lane.

tokens.name: horse-width
tokens.usage: Horse on the track (viewBox 120 × 80).

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Smallest button height in the panel; 40px in the report.

tokens.name: report-max
tokens.usage: Report content width at 1280.

duration.note: Motion durations. Under prefers-reduced-motion every one of these is 0ms and the horse jumps to its spot.

tokens.name: dur-gallop
tokens.usage: One full 4-frame gallop loop.

tokens.name: dur-run-in
tokens.usage: The single run from mid-track to the finish.

tokens.name: dur-stripe
tokens.usage: Turf stripes scroll one stripe-pitch.

tokens.name: dur-quick
tokens.usage: Hover, press, toggle.

tokens.name: dur-sheet
tokens.usage: Consent sheet and toast enter.

tokens.name: ease-run
tokens.usage: The run-in: eases out into the finish, no overshoot.

tokens.name: ease-ui
tokens.usage: Sheets, toasts, toggles.

tokens.name: ease-linear
tokens.usage: Gallop frames (steps) and stripe scroll.
